name: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models
certifications: No single required certification; assessed by training runs, evaluation reports and a deployed model
Optional: NVIDIA Generative AI LLM certifications
tools: Hugging Face Transformers, Datasets, PEFT and TRL

beginner.summary: For developers and ML engineers who build with LLMs and need to adapt open-weight models to their own tasks. Covers when to fine-tune instead of prompting or retrieval, how models are trained, setting up GPUs and libraries, choosing a base model, tokenizers and chat templates, preparing and cleaning training data, supervised fine-tuning with TRL, LoRA and QLoRA, hyperparameters, monitoring training, evaluation with held-out sets and judges, faster training with Unsloth, merging and saving models, serving, managed fine-tuning services and costs, licences and responsible use.
prerequisites: Writes Python and has used an LLM API
Basic understanding of machine learning training and evaluation
Access to a GPU, a cloud notebook or a managed fine-tuning service
outcomes: Decide when fine-tuning is worth it compared with prompting or retrieval
Prepare clean chat-format datasets and fine-tune open-weight models with LoRA and QLoRA
Evaluate fine-tuned models against baselines with held-out data and judges
Merge, save and serve a fine-tuned model and estimate its cost

days.topic: Fine-Tuning LLMs Overview: When to Fine-Tune, Prompt or Retrieve
subtopics: What fine-tuning changes in a model
Problems fine-tuning solves: format, style, task skill and cost
Problems it does not solve well: fresh facts and missing knowledge
Costs and time at a glance
The course project: a support assistant for a fictional company
days.lab_task: Take five candidate use cases, decide for each whether to prompt, retrieve or fine-tune with reasons, and for the course project write the success criteria a fine-tuned model must beat.
days.deliverable: Use case decisions and project success criteria
checks: Each use case has a justified approach
The project has measurable criteria and a baseline
The limits of fine-tuning for new facts are stated correctly
objectives: Choose between prompting, retrieval and fine-tuning

subtopics: What changes in weights during fine-tuning
days.lab_task: Compare a base model and its instruct version on the same ten prompts, read both model cards and explain the differences in behaviour from their training stages.
days.deliverable: Base and instruct comparison with explanations
checks: Both models answer the same prompts
Training stages are summarised from the model cards
Behaviour differences are linked to training stages
objectives: Tell base and instruct models apart

days.topic: Environment Setup: GPUs, Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face
subtopics: GPU options: local, cloud notebooks and rented instances
GPU memory and why it limits model size
CUDA drivers and checking the GPU
Hugging Face accounts and access tokens
Checking the setup with a small model

days.deliverable: Working training environment with memory notes
checks: nvidia-smi and PyTorch both see the GPU

Licences: Apache 2.0, community licences and restrictions

days.deliverable: Model shortlist with memory estimates and test results
checks: Licence terms are summarised for each model
Training and inference memory is estimated
Each model is scored on project prompts

days.topic: Tokenizers and Chat Templates

days.deliverable: Template notebook with a broken and fixed example
checks: Conversations are formatted with the model's template
Token counts are reported for the dataset sample
The wrong-template output is shown and corrected

days.topic: Preparing a Supervised Fine-Tuning Dataset
subtopics: What a training example looks like
Sources: tickets, documents and expert answers
Storing datasets with Hugging Face Datasets

No example appears in more than one split

days.topic: Training Hyperparameters: Learning Rate, Epochs and Batch Size

days.topic: Evaluating Fine-Tuned Models: Held-Out Sets and Task Metrics

Comparing with the base model and prompting baseline

days.deliverable: Evaluation report with error analysis
checks: All three systems are scored on the same test set

The report states whether success criteria are met

days.topic: LLM-as-Judge Evaluation and Its Limits

days.deliverable: Judge setup with agreement analysis
checks: Pairwise results are produced for two models
Agreement with human ratings is measured

subtopics: Throughput and latency basics in practice
Applying the chat template at serving time

days.deliverable: Running endpoint, client and load test results

The GGUF model runs in Ollama

days.topic: Managed Fine-Tuning Services: OpenAI, Azure, Vertex AI and Bedrock
subtopics: Supported methods: supervised, preference and reinforcement fine-tuning
tools: OpenAI fine-tuning API or Azure AI Foundry

days.topic: Costs, Licences and Responsible Fine-Tuning

days.deliverable: Cost estimate, rights check and checklist
checks: Training and serving costs are estimated with assumptions

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Fine-Tuned Support Assistant from Data to Endpoint
days.lab_task: Deliver the course project end to end: prepare and clean the dataset, fine-tune with QLoRA, evaluate against base and prompted baselines, publish a model card and serve the model behind an endpoint.
days.deliverable: Dataset, model, evaluation report and endpoint
checks: The fine-tuned model is trained from the cleaned dataset
The model meets the success criteria on the test set

intermediate.summary: For ML engineers who have fine-tuned models with LoRA and now need better data, alignment methods and scale. Covers designing fine-tuning projects, synthetic data and distillation, instruction data mixtures, preference optimisation with DPO, ORPO and KTO, reinforcement fine-tuning with GRPO, reward models, fine-tuning for tool calling and structured output, domain adaptation, continued pretraining, multi-GPU training, memory and speed techniques, Axolotl and LLaMA-Factory, embedding and reranker models, small models, vision-language models, benchmark and safety evaluation, catastrophic forgetting and reproducible runs.
prerequisites: Has fine-tuned an open-weight model with LoRA or QLoRA
Comfortable with PyTorch and Hugging Face libraries
outcomes: Build high-quality instruction and preference datasets, including synthetic data
Align models with DPO and GRPO and fine-tune for tools, formats and domains
Train efficiently on several GPUs with configured frameworks
Evaluate capability, safety and regressions before release

days.topic: Designing Fine-Tuning Projects: Goals, Baselines and Success Criteria

checks: Refusal examples are included and tested

Win rates against the supervised model are reported

days.topic: Embedding Model and Reranker Fine-Tuning

days.deliverable: Fine-tuned retrieval models and RAG comparison
checks: Recall and MRR improve over the base models

days.topic: Fine-Tuning Small Language Models for Edge and Cost

Matching model size to the task

days.lab_task: Build a domain assistant with supervised and DPO training on mixed human and synthetic data, add tool calling, evaluate capability, safety and forgetting and present the release decision.
days.deliverable: Trained assistant, evaluation pack and release decision

advanced.summary: For senior ML engineers and leads who run custom model programmes. Covers fine-tuning strategy, large-scale data pipelines, training larger models on clusters, long-context fine-tuning, advanced adapter methods, model merging, distillation, reinforcement learning at scale, multi-adapter serving, quantisation for deployment, inference optimisation, evaluation platforms and release gates, contamination and privacy, governance and licensing, model security, lifecycle management, cost engineering, training agents for multi-step work and troubleshooting failed runs.
prerequisites: Has trained and released fine-tuned models with preference methods
Comfortable with multi-GPU training and evaluation tooling
Responsible for model quality, cost or platform decisions
outcomes: Decide where custom models pay off and run a fine-tuning programme
Train, merge, distil and align models at scale
Serve many fine-tuned models efficiently with quantisation and adapters
Govern, secure and operate custom models through their lifecycle

days.deliverable: Use case assessment and fine-tuning strategy
checks: Each use case is compared with an API baseline
The portfolio is justified by cost and quality
objectives: Decide where custom models pay off
